summary.motive: Sell the bubble-screen picture to trigger the force defenders uphill, then convert the slot to a glance vertical that attacks the vacated seam.
summary.whyItWorks: Every offensive cue screams screen — the arc, the flare, the arm flash — so the nickel abandons his deep responsibility at full speed and cannot recover once the slot plants behind him.
summary.failureMode: The nickel stays patient and sinks rather than triggers, playing the slot's hips through the plant and staying attached to the glance.

beats.title: 1. The Bubble Picture Is Painted
beats.text: The slot bubbles outside while the back flares into the flat and the quarterback flashes his screen arm. Every cue points to a perimeter throw.

beats.title: 2. The Trigger Commits
beats.text: The nickel bites fully, sprinting up to strangle the screen at the numbers. The flat defender follows the picture instead of sinking with the slot.

beats.title: 3. The Plant Converts
beats.text: At full bubble speed the slot plants and converts straight upfield, passing behind the committed trigger. The corner is already cleared by the go route.

beats.title: 4. The Glance Over the Top
beats.text: The quarterback transfers from the fake posture and delivers the glance over the hook linebacker. The post safety is leaning the wrong way as it lands.

relations.tell: The slot's first two steps carry him toward the sideline like a true bubble — but a real bubble keeps flattening; this one plants and climbs at the numbers.
